lines.en: Would you like to respond to this message?
: I can't wait to tell Rin you sent this to me and cause even more drama in your life.
: I can't wait until you're dead.
: Just kidding.
: Maybe.
: Are you enjoying the picture you received in exchange?
: I'm trying to, but some creep keeps texting me and I don't know how to make him go away.
: You should just talk to him instead. He can probably do more for you than a picture ever could.
: I doubt it. He seems like a loser and probably doesn't practice safe sex. And also, I'm an obedient Christian girl.
: My favorite kind.
: Ew.
: Are you actually religious?
: That's a weird question to ask someone who just sent you a picture of a naked girl.
: You can be religious and still send people pictures of naked girls.
: By any chance, did the part of your brain that processes sarcasm go to shit during your coma? I don't know if I should feel bad for you or not.
: I'm just trying to learn more about you.
: Not the reaction I expected from sending you a naked picture of my ex.
: Why? I think this is a good bonding experience for us.
: Yeah, I think we could get a lot closer if you sent me more pictures of your hot idol girlfriend.
: How about one of me instead?
: Please don't. I like this phone and I don't want to have to throw it away.
: I wouldn't have sent one anyway.
: Cool. Can you go away now so I can get back to doing my homework?
: You're not doing your homework, Otoha. We both know that.
: Then why even point it out????? Why will you not let me be free?????
: Because I'm in love with you.
: Okay.
: Will you accept my feelings?
: Who is this again?
: Rin. You've been set up.
: Hi Rin.
: How could you betray me like this?
: Finger slipped. Sorry.
: Remember the first time we made out? Can you please recap that in vivid details please?
: Sure.
: It all started one snowy winter night in my grandfather's log cabin. I'd just returned from a week-long bear hunt and was excited to finally get to watch Wheel of Fortune with my cat.
: I lied. It's still me, your former teacher.
: Otoha I really want to kill myself.
: Is someone paying you to prevent me from getting off? How am I supposed to do my homework now?
: I have teaching experience. I can come help you.
: No, you might kill yourself on the way.
: Yeah, good point.
: Do you actually need me to call you right now?
: No, I'll be fine.
: Are you sure?
: Yeah. Go do your homework. I'm sorry for bothering you.
: Okay.
: You can text me again later if you want. I don't care.
: Maybe. Later, Otoha.
: Later, Akira :)
